question: Why do entities offered into the fire of awareness kindle that fire?
premises: Entities properly offered by method into the fire within one's own awareness abandon division and difference.
By their own power those same entities kindle that fire of awareness.
The abandonment of difference and the kindling occur together in the act of offering.
inference: Entities offered into awareness both lose their separateness and intensify the fire of awareness by their own power.
plain_english: When entities are properly offered by method into the fire within one's own awareness, they abandon the division of difference and, by their own power, kindle that very fire.
